_forced_change_2: clump_index_block 60 -> 0. index_probe on the hero groom reads ratio 1.0026 at stride 1 against the pack groom's 0.0331: consecutive-index roots here are exactly as far apart as random pairs, because author_hero_hair.py samples roots by AREA WEIGHT and emits no authored patch order.
